exposure: high-dosage induction protocol (50 µg oral misoprostol 2-3 times daily)
low-dosage induction protocol (25 µg oral misoprostol up to 8 times daily)
finding: The low-dosage misoprostol induction protocol (25 µg) was associated with a higher probability of vaginal delivery but with a higher risk of vacuum extraction compared to the high-dosage protocol (50 µg).
mod_finding: The low-dosage induction protocol was associated with a higher probability of vaginal delivery but also a higher risk of vacuum extraction compared to a high-dosage protocol.
